hero.title: ProyectoEspaña.dev
hero.slogan:
Equip the Sentinels!
So the world knows!

p1.texto: ProyectoEspaña.dev is a private initiative that equips the people who document what happens on Spanish soil and tell the world about it.

p2.texto: The Ceuta invasion, the Valencia flash floods, storm Filomena, the La Palma volcano. Events the world needs to see in detail and as they happen, not three days later and summarised.

p3.texto: You have to move fast, and you cannot broadcast with a phone in your hand. At night you see nothing without a thermal camera. What you need to show is far away, or moving, or you need to be able to leave quickly. Sometimes the place is not safe and there is no vehicle to leave in.

p4.texto: Gear that frees your hands and survives the terrain, training to use it well, and a technical organisation that coordinates broadcasting, storage and distribution.

p5.texto: Through crowdfunding campaigns. Each one states what gear it needs, for whom and what for.
